Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Fixed PvP combat frames, pressure, survival helpers, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed overlay-only Self/S1-S5 combat frames, pressure and CC cues, optional Smart Recuperate, accepted-Eukrasia Smart Kardia, low-MP Focus, exact DRK macro helpers, fail-closed assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds default-off fixed overlay-only Combat Frames for Self and stable S1-S5 rows, plus a default-off held-key Smart Recuperate at 16,000+ missing HP and 2,000+ MP. Smart Kardia now opens one short-lived opportunity only after an accepted PvP Eukrasia call and causal charge/status evidence; the old continuous held-key scanner and six-second throttle are removed. Speculative low-HP pre-Guard is removed while the verified post-Purify Guard follow-up remains. PLD Guardian is now an independent Job Tool. Configuration schema 26 migrates prior explicit opt-ins safely; native FFXIV HUD and selected targets remain untouched.
